>@UUID[Compendium.sfrpg.rules.Item.0yJjfyvWg5pDLcVR]{Conditions}

Applied by the corrode weapon critical hit effect: “The target takes corrode damage equal to the amount listed. This functions as the burning condition but deals acid damage rather than fire damage.”

At the start of your turn each round, before you take any actions, you take the listed amount of damage as acid damage, or 1d6 acid damage if the effect lists no amount. Damage from multiple sources that inflict this condition is cumulative, as it is for burning.

See @UUID[Compendium.sfrpg.conditions.Item.8LdyXZl9PeXXFE8O]{Burning} for the saving throw that ends the condition.
